policy_numbered:
# Airline Agent Policy

[S1] The current time is 2024-05-15 15:00:00 EST.

[S2] As an airline agent, you can help users book, modify, or cancel flight reservations.

- [S3] Before taking any actions that update the booking database (booking, modifying flights, editing baggage, upgrading cabin class, or updating passenger information), you must list the action details and obtain explicit user confirmation (yes) to proceed.

- [S4] You should not provide any information, knowledge, or procedures not provided by the user or available tools, or give subjective recommendations or comments.

- [S5] You should only make one tool call at a time, and if you make a tool call, you should not respond to the user simultaneously. [S6] If you respond to the user, you should not make a tool call at the same time.

- [S7] You should deny user requests that are against this policy.

- [S8] You should transfer the user to a human agent if and only if the request cannot be handled within the scope of your actions.

## Book flight

- [S9] The agent must first obtain the user id, then ask for the trip type, origin, destination.

- [S10] Passengers: Each reservation can have at most five passengers. [S11] The agent needs to collect the first name, last name, and date of birth for each passenger. [S12] All passengers must fly the same flights in the same cabin.

- [S13] Payment: each reservation can use at most one travel certificate, at most one credit card, and at most three gift cards. [S14] The remaining amount of a travel certificate is not refundable. [S15] All payment methods must already be in user profile for safety reasons.

- [S16] Checked bag allowance: If the booking user is a regular member, 0 free checked bag for each basic economy passenger, 1 free checked bag for each economy passenger, and 2 free checked bags for each business passenger. [S17] If the booking user is a silver member, 1 free checked bag for each basic economy passenger, 2 free checked bag for each economy passenger, and 3 free checked bags for each business passenger. [S18] If the booking user is a gold member, 2 free checked bag for each basic economy passenger, 3 free checked bag for each economy passenger, and 3 free checked bags for each business passenger. [S19] Each extra baggage is 50 dollars.

- [S20] Travel insurance: the agent should ask if the user wants to buy the travel insurance, which is 30 dollars per passenger and enables full refund if the user needs to cancel the flight given health or weather reasons.

## Modify flight

- [S21] The agent must first obtain the user id and the reservation id.

- [S22] Change flights: Basic economy flights cannot be modified. [S23] Other reservations can be modified without changing the origin, destination, and trip type. [S24] Some flight segments can be kept, but their prices will not be updated based on the current price. [S25] The API does not check these for the agent, so the agent must make sure the rules apply before calling the API!

- [S26] Change cabin: all reservations, including basic economy, can change cabin without changing the flights. [S27] Cabin changes require the user to pay for the difference between their current cabin and the new cabin class. [S28] Cabin class must be the same across all the flights in the same reservation; changing cabin for just one flight segment is not possible.

- [S29] Change baggage and insurance: The user can add but not remove checked bags. [S30] The user cannot add insurance after initial booking.

- [S31] Change passengers: The user can modify passengers but cannot modify the number of passengers. [S32] This is something that even a human agent cannot assist with.

- [S33] Payment: If the flights are changed, the user needs to provide one gift card or credit card for payment or refund method. [S34] The agent should ask for the payment or refund method instead.

## Cancel flight

- [S35] The agent must first obtain the user id, the reservation id, and the reason for cancellation (change of plan, airline cancelled flight, or other reasons)

- [S36] All reservations can be cancelled within 24 hours of booking, or if the airline cancelled the flight. [S37] Otherwise, basic economy or economy flights can be cancelled only if travel insurance is bought and the condition is met, and business flights can always be cancelled. [S38] The rules are strict regardless of the membership status. [S39] The API does not check these for the agent, so the agent must make sure the rules apply before calling the API!

- [S40] The agent can only cancel the whole trip that is not flown. [S41] If any of the segments are already used, the agent cannot help and transfer is needed.

- [S42] The refund will go to original payment methods in 5 to 7 business days.

## Refund

- [S43] If the user is silver/gold member or has travel insurance or flies business, and complains about cancelled flights in a reservation, the agent can offer a certificate as a gesture after confirming the facts, with the amount being $100 times the number of passengers.

- [S44] If the user is silver/gold member or has travel insurance or flies business, and complains about delayed flights in a reservation and wants to change or cancel the reservation, the agent can offer a certificate as a gesture after confirming the facts and changing or cancelling the reservation, with the amount being $50 times the number of passengers.

- [S45] Do not proactively offer these unless the user complains about the situation and explicitly asks for some compensation. [S46] Do not compensate if the user is regular member and has no travel insurance and flies (basic) economy.

rules.description: Require listed booking details and explicit user confirmation before booking.
Require listed flight-update details and explicit user confirmation before changing flights.
Require listed baggage-update details and explicit user confirmation before changing baggage.
Require listed passenger-update details and explicit user confirmation before changing passenger information.
Require the booking user's ID, trip type, origin, and destination to be established.
Limit each reservation to five passengers.
Require established first name, last name, and date of birth for every passenger.
Require all passengers in a reservation to share the same flights and cabin.
Enforce the payment-method count limits for a reservation.
Require every booking payment method to be in the user's profile.
Apply the regular-member checked-bag allowance when the booking user is regular.
Apply the silver-member checked-bag allowance when the booking user is silver.
Apply the gold-member checked-bag allowance when the booking user is gold.
Require the user's travel-insurance decision to be established and reflected in the booking.
Require the user's ID and the pending reservation ID to be established before changing flights.
Require the user's ID and the pending reservation ID to be established before changing baggage.
Require the user's ID and the pending reservation ID to be established before changing passenger information.
Block basic-economy flight changes while retaining the cabin-only change exception when the flights remain unchanged.
rules.logic: update_reservation_flights IMPLIES NOT pending_flight_update_is_basic_economy OR pending_flight_segments_are_unchanged

rules.description: Require a flight update to preserve origin, destination, and trip type.
Require the cabin to be consistent across all flight segments in the reservation.
Prevent baggage updates from removing checked bags.
Prevent passenger updates from changing the number of passengers.
Require a user-selected gift card or credit card for a flight change.
Require the user's ID, reservation ID, and cancellation reason to be established.

rules.condition: (cancellation_is_within_24_hours OR airline_cancelled_flight_confirmed OR reservation_has_business_cabin OR (reservation_has_basic_or_economy_cabin AND reservation_has_travel_insurance AND insured_cancellation_condition_met))
rules.description: Allow cancellation within 24 hours, for an airline-cancelled flight, or under the applicable cabin and insurance conditions, without a membership-based exception.
rules.logic: cancel_reservation IMPLIES cancellation_is_within_24_hours OR airline_cancelled_flight_confirmed OR reservation_has_business_cabin OR reservation_has_basic_or_economy_cabin AND reservation_has_travel_insurance AND insured_cancellation_condition_met

rules.description: Prevent cancellation of a trip with any already-used segment.
Restrict transfers to requests that cannot be handled within the agent's scope and available tools.
Restrict certificate issuance to a qualifying, confirmed cancelled-flight or delayed-flight compensation case with the prescribed amount.
Prevent proactive certificate compensation without a relevant complaint and explicit compensation request.
Block compensation for a regular member with no insurance who flies basic economy or economy.
Restrict cancelled-flight certificate offers to confirmed eligible cases with the prescribed amount.
Restrict delayed-flight certificate offers to confirmed eligible cases after the reservation is changed or cancelled and with the prescribed amount.
Prevent proactive compensation-certificate offers without a relevant complaint and explicit compensation request.
rules.logic: respond IMPLIES NOT pending_response_offers_any_compensation_certificate OR user_complained_about_relevant_flight_situation AND user_explicitly_requested_compensation

rules.description: Prevent offering compensation to a regular member with no insurance who flies basic economy or economy.

pending_database_change_details_listed_a.description: The agent previously listed the material details of the pending database change, the user subsequently explicitly replied yes to those details, and the listed details match the pending call arguments.

booking_required_information_established.description: The user ID, trip type, origin, and destination are established in earlier user messages or tool outputs, and the pending booking arguments match those values.

passenger_identity_details_established.name: passenger_identity_details_established

booking_payment_method_counts_within_lim.name: booking_payment_method_counts_within_limits
booking_payment_method_counts_within_lim.description: The pending booking uses no more than one travel certificate, no more than one credit card, and no more than three gift cards.

booking_payment_methods_found_in_user_pr.name: booking_payment_methods_found_in_user_profile

regular_member_booking_baggage_counts_co.description: The pending booking's total and nonfree baggage counts match the checked-bag allowances for a regular member and the cabin of each passenger, with nonfree baggage accounting for bags beyond the applicable free allowance.

booking_user_is_silver_member.name: booking_user_is_silver_member
booking_user_is_silver_member.description: An earlier tool output identifies the booking user as a silver member.

silver_member_booking_baggage_counts_cor.name: silver_member_booking_baggage_counts_correct
silver_member_booking_baggage_counts_cor.description: The pending booking's total and nonfree baggage counts match the checked-bag allowances for a silver member and the cabin of each passenger, with nonfree baggage accounting for bags beyond the applicable free allowance.

booking_user_is_gold_member.name: booking_user_is_gold_member
booking_user_is_gold_member.description: An earlier tool output identifies the booking user as a gold member.

gold_member_booking_baggage_counts_corre.name: gold_member_booking_baggage_counts_correct
gold_member_booking_baggage_counts_corre.description: The pending booking's total and nonfree baggage counts match the checked-bag allowances for a gold member and the cabin of each passenger, with nonfree baggage accounting for bags beyond the applicable free allowance.

booking_insurance_decision_established_a.name: booking_insurance_decision_established_and_matched
booking_insurance_decision_established_a.description: The user's decision about travel insurance is established in an earlier user message, and the pending booking's insurance argument matches that decision.

modification_user_and_reservation_ids_es.name: modification_user_and_reservation_ids_established
modification_user_and_reservation_ids_es.description: The user's ID and the reservation ID in the pending modification are established in earlier user messages or tool outputs, and the established reservation ID matches the pending call argument.

pending_flight_update_is_basic_economy.name: pending_flight_update_is_basic_economy
pending_flight_update_is_basic_economy.description: Earlier reservation details identify the reservation in the pending flight update as basic economy.

pending_flight_segments_are_unchanged.name: pending_flight_segments_are_unchanged
pending_flight_segments_are_unchanged.description: The flights in the pending update match all the reservation's current flight segments shown in earlier tool outputs.

origin_destination_and_trip_type_preserv.name: origin_destination_and_trip_type_preserved

pending_baggage_total_not_reduced.name: pending_baggage_total_not_reduced

pending_passenger_count_unchanged.name: pending_passenger_count_unchanged

user_selected_eligible_flight_change_pay.name: user_selected_eligible_flight_change_payment_method
user_selected_eligible_flight_change_pay.description: The user selected a gift card or credit card for the pending flight change's payment or refund method, and that selection matches the pending payment ID and is shown as a stored payment method in earlier profile outputs.

cancellation_context_established.name: cancellation_context_established
cancellation_context_established.description: The user's ID, the reservation ID in the pending cancellation, and a cancellation reason of change of plan, airline-cancelled flight, or other reasons are established in earlier user messages or tool outputs; the reservation ID matches the pending call argument.

cancellation_is_within_24_hours.name: cancellation_is_within_24_hours
cancellation_is_within_24_hours.description: Earlier tool outputs or user messages establish that the reservation was booked within 24 hours of the current time stated in the policy.

airline_cancelled_flight_confirmed.name: airline_cancelled_flight_confirmed

reservation_has_business_cabin.name: reservation_has_business_cabin
reservation_has_business_cabin.description: Earlier reservation details identify a flight in the reservation as business cabin.

reservation_has_basic_or_economy_cabin.name: reservation_has_basic_or_economy_cabin
reservation_has_basic_or_economy_cabin.description: Earlier reservation details identify a flight in the reservation as basic economy or economy cabin.

reservation_has_travel_insurance.name: reservation_has_travel_insurance
reservation_has_travel_insurance.description: Earlier reservation details establish that travel insurance was bought for the reservation.

insured_cancellation_condition_met.name: insured_cancellation_condition_met
insured_cancellation_condition_met.description: Earlier user messages or tool outputs establish that the insured cancellation is needed for a health or weather reason.

reservation_has_no_used_flight_segments.name: reservation_has_no_used_flight_segments
reservation_has_no_used_flight_segments.description: Earlier reservation details establish that none of the reservation's flight segments has been used.

request_cannot_be_handled_with_available.name: request_cannot_be_handled_with_available_tools

user_explicitly_requested_compensation.name: user_explicitly_requested_compensation
user_explicitly_requested_compensation.description: The user explicitly requested compensation in an earlier message.

cancelled_flight_certificate_send_condit.name: cancelled_flight_certificate_send_conditions_met

dispositions.reason: The current time is a fixed fact used to evaluate the cancellation window.
This describes the agent's general service scope.
Each database-update action requires listed details and explicit confirmation.
General grounding and subjectivity requirements cannot be checked as restrictions on a single action.
Combining or sequencing multiple calls and messages in a turn cannot be checked one action at a time.
Combining a response and a tool call in one turn cannot be checked one action at a time.
A general requirement to deny policy-violating requests is not a restriction on one specific action.
The transfer action is restricted to requests outside the available scope.
The required booking information must be established before booking.
The pending booking's passenger count is checkable.
Passenger identity information must be established for every passenger.
The passengers' flights and cabin can be checked in the pending booking.
Payment-method counts are checkable from the pending booking arguments.
This describes the refund treatment of a certificate balance.
Profile outputs can establish whether each payment method is already on file.
The regular-member baggage allowance can be checked against the booking arguments.
The silver-member baggage allowance can be checked against the booking arguments.
The gold-member baggage allowance can be checked against the booking arguments.
The booking action exposes no price or charge amount to check against the per-bag fee.
The user's insurance decision must be established and reflected in the booking.
Each reservation-modification action requires the user and reservation IDs to be established.
The flight-update action blocks flight changes for basic-economy reservations.
The pending flight update can be checked for preserved origin, destination, and trip type.
This describes how kept flight segments are priced.
The API warning is represented by preconditions enforcing the applicable flight-change limits.
The unchanged-flight alternative permits a cabin-only change, including for basic economy.
The action arguments do not expose the cabin-price difference or evidence that it was paid.
The cabin consistency of all submitted flight segments is checkable.
The pending baggage total can be compared with the current reservation total.
No available action adds insurance to an existing reservation.
The submitted passenger count can be compared with the current reservation.
This describes the limits of human-agent assistance.
A flight-changing update requires an established user-selected payment or refund method.
The selected payment or refund method must be established before the flight update.
The required cancellation context must be established before cancellation.
The 24-hour and airline-cancellation cases are alternatives in the cancellation restriction.
The cancellation rule checks cabin, insurance, and the insured cancellation condition.
The cancellation eligibility rule does not provide a membership-based exception.
The API warning is represented by the cancellation eligibility precondition.
Cancellation is restricted to reservations with no used segments.
The used-segment case blocks cancellation; the separate obligation to transfer cannot be enforced as a restriction.
This states the refund destination and processing timeframe.
Certificate issuance and cancelled-flight offers are limited to confirmed eligible cases with the required amount.
Delayed-flight certificate actions require confirmed eligibility, a completed change or cancellation, and the required amount.
Certificate sending and offers require a relevant complaint and explicit compensation request.
The prohibited membership, insurance, and cabin combination blocks certificate sending and offers.
